text.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ لِإِيلَٰفِ قُرَيْشٍ

translations.asad: SO THAT the Quraysh might remain secure,
translations.sahih: For the accustomed security of the Quraysh -

translations.asad: secure in their winter and summer journeys,
translations.sahih: Their accustomed security [in] the caravan of winter and summer -

translations.asad: Let them, therefore, worship the Sustainer of this Temple;
translations.sahih: Let them worship the Lord of this House,

text.arabic: ٱلَّذِىٓ أَطْعَمَهُم مِّن جُوعٍۢ وَءَامَنَهُم مِّنْ خَوْفٍۭ

translations.asad: who has given them food against hunger, and made them safe from danger.
translations.sahih: Who has fed them, [saving them] from hunger and made them safe, [saving them] from fear.
